Near the 50 Metres made contact with FORERUNNER due to both runners shifting ground.  Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  Sent for sampling post-race. Shortly after the start was steadied when crowded between GOLDEN EMPIRE which shifted in slightly and LEADING AGILITY which was taken out by FORERUNNER.  Approaching the 400 Metres was hampered when taken wider by LEADING AGILITY which shifted out when being checked.  Passing the 300 Metres K C Leung dropped his left rein for a number of strides when racing tight between GOLDEN EMPIRE and LEADING AGILITY. Jumped only fairly.  Bumped leaving the 600 Metres.  When questioned regarding his riding from the 600 Metres and as to whether there was an opportunity to follow SAME TO YOU into the race E Brown stated that his instructions were to obtain cover and he had expected to take a handy position where his mount ultimately settled.  He said after following CAPTAIN LINK during the race he was reluctant to shift out and follow SAME TO YOU as he felt that runner had a tough run with the race being run inside of standard time and he was of the opinion that horse would not provide him with the opportunity to improve into the event.  He said for this reason he remained racing behind CAPTAIN LINIK, however, when FORERUNNER improved quickly to his outside near the 500 Metres and CAPTAIN LINK did not improve, this resulted in YOUNG ARROW being held up for clear running making the Home Turn before finishing the race off reasonably well in the Home Straight.  Trainer D J Whyte confirmed the instructions were to obtain cover but expressed disappointment with Jockey Brown’s decision not to shift out to follow SAME TO YOU after the 600 Metres.  Jockey Brown agreed with the Stewards that he had made an error of judgement by not shifting to the outside of CAPTAIN LINK after the 600 Metres which would have resulted in his mount obtaining clear running on the Home Turn and into the Home Straight.  Jockey Brown was advised that in future he would be expected to show better judgement than he did on this occasion.  Sent for sampling post-race.
